newsitem.title: ITALY: Comit cuts prime rate by 75 bp to 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Comit cuts prime rate by 75 bp to 10 pct.

text.p: Banca Commerciale Italiana said on Thursday it was cutting its prime rate by 75 basis points to 10 percent, effective October 28.
It said its top rate to clients would also be reduced to 17 percent from 17.75 percent on that date.

The move follows a 75 basis point reduction by the Bank of Italy in the discount rate to 7.50 percent from 8.25 percent late on Wednesday, which has triggered a string of other Italian banks to follow suit and cut their prime and top rates.
